title: Max and Ms. Soohoo
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: At recess, Max runs fast on the blacktop. Too fast! Max trips and scrapes a knee.
Ow! It stings. A tear rolls down Max's face.
The teacher on duty helps Max up. "Let's go see Ms. Soohoo," she says. A friend walks with Max to the front office.
Ms. Soohoo sits at the big desk by the front door. She knows the name of every kid at McKinley.
"Hi, Max," she says in a kind voice. "Let's take care of that knee."
She washes the scrape and puts on a bandage. Then she gives Max an ice pack shaped like a little bear.
"Do you want me to call your family?" she asks. Max thinks about it and says, "No, thank you. I feel better now."
Ms. Soohoo writes a note to take home, so Max's family will know what happened.
Max walks back to class with the bear ice pack. Max does not run on the blacktop anymore. Well, not as fast!
